head: aff21b0dde6c97648eaffe9084b030b0670f3f0a
classification_reasons: Blast radius is large regardless of the proof fix: plan.md's Files that change still reaches core gate infrastructure used at every (c)/(d)/(e) gate for every project on the plugin (plugin/gate/checks.py, plugin/gate/diff.py, plugin/state/unpark.py, plugin/pr/description.py), plus the adversarial-reviewer agent, two templates/skills and OPERATING_MODEL.

The code this design prescribes is wholly new (a rename-aware --name-status -M parser, a committed-tree tree_files helper, a new gate check, cross-check union logic, a plan-at-merge-base declaration reader); no existing test exercises any of it today, so 'code the existing tests already cover' does not hold.

The spec reached this state only after two rounds of panel correction (the eval-case survivor-vs-drop design gap, and now the Proof-coverage gap for declared-ok outcomes and the rename-is-a-drop case) — a tight, no-open-concern spec on the first pass this is not, even though both confirmed gaps are now closed.
attempted: Intent: re-compared intent.md's Proposed outcome against spec.md's Requirements/Design and plan.md; the shape of the fix (parallel ratchets check, unpark.py union, plan-declared exemption, risk-list-shaped hit, skip-marker listing) still matches intent.md throughout; no substitution found.

Spec and plan, gap closure: read decisions-b.json's round-3 panel entry (confirmed reasons 1 and 2 of the prior adversarial review: eval-case declared-ok outcomes untested, test-file rename-is-a-drop outcome untested; reason 3, skip-marker config-file surface, downgraded to a non-blocking nit). Checked plan.md's current Proof list against the panel's stated remedy ('add Proof items for the eval-case declared-via-Files-that-change and declared-via-Proof-item outcomes, and for the test-file R-is-a-drop outcome') and found exactly three new items doing exactly that: test_ratchets_rename_out_of_test_paths_is_a_drop (an R whose source matches a test_paths glob and destination matches none fails with details.hits['ratchet: tests'] naming the file — matches spec.md Requirements' own R-drop clause, which Acceptance never named a test for before); test_ratchets_drop_eval_case_declared_in_files_that_change_ok and test_ratchets_drop_eval_case_declared_in_proof_ok (the same emptied-case drop, declared via each of the two declaration mechanisms, including the trailing-slash directory-match nuance spec.md's Design calls out as the likeliest place for a matching bug) — is ok. Verified these are not just plausibly-named additions: each test's one-line description in plan.md names the exact input (R not matching any test_paths glob; emptied eval-case folder plus a Files-that-change or Proof-line declaration) and the exact expected outcome (fails naming the file / is ok), which is what spec.md's Requirements and Acceptance actually ask for, not an adjacent behavior. No new gap introduced by the edit: spec.md's Acceptance and Requirements text is unchanged, only plan.md's Proof section and 'Files that change'/Order of work (marketplace.json version lockstep, already requested by the owner's PR review) were touched this round, consistent with a phase-(b) document-only commit.

Spec and plan, order and coverage otherwise: re-walked every Requirements/Acceptance bullet against plan.md's Proof list; found no other named behavior left without a named test. Flagged concerns are all [x] closed, each citing the panel decision that closed it; the two panel decisions in decisions-b.json/decisions-b.md match spec.md's Flagged-concerns text verbatim.

Proof vs diff: diff-b.patch's --stat header shows only changes/0005-.../{spec.md,plan.md,status.yaml,evidence/*} touched — no plugin/template/docs source file is edited yet, correct for a phase-(b) design-only commit; code and its tests are deferred to phase (c) per plan.md's Order of work. Did not cite or rely on gate-b.json, claude-b.json, run-b.json or the committed adversarial-review-b.json (all written for earlier HEADs, 9d4301b0/6c6f002c) as evidence for or against this HEAD; this verdict rests on an independent re-read of the current spec.md/plan.md text and decisions-b.json.

Blast radius: no guardrail file (.claude/**, CLAUDE.md, REVIEW.md, sdlc.yaml) and no sdlc.yaml risk_list item is touched by this commit; the new check's eventual files are all named in plan.md's Files-that-change with no scope creep beyond spec.md's Design.

Policies: security-baseline rules 2/6 (argument-list git invocation, no shell=True) still correctly shape the diff.py design; data-conventions and ux-conventions non-applicability claims are unchanged and still correctly reasoned.

Tests (angle 6): confirmed the two panel-confirmed Proof gaps are closed by tests that actually assert the outcomes spec.md requires (not merely plausibly-named stubs), and that the one gap the panel declined to force (skip-marker config-file scan surface) was correctly left as a nit, not silently dropped — fix-response history and decisions-b.json both show it was a deliberate, adjudicated non-fix, not an oversight.
